//: The tools spark depends on (P82, docs/2026-10-03-tools-design.md). A person's ~/.local/share/spark/tools.json and a project's .spark/tools.json override any field of any entry; the project wins. `roles` points a job at a tool; `contracts` says what the job needs, and only this file states them.

pdftotext.for: reading a datasheet page by page (parts.py --read)

wokwi-cli.for: compiling custom chips (free, local) and running Wokwi scenarios (paid minutes)
wokwi-cli.needs_account: a Wokwi token in WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN — create one at wokwi.com/dashboard/ci

circuit-to-wokwi.for: turning the built board into a Wokwi diagram

node.for: running the bundled converter and npm tools
